messages:
Nora: Quick alert — we've seen increasing packet drop counters from two NIC firmware revisions on apac-west1 racks during peak load. Ops has a maintenance window proposal: rolling NIC microcode refresh + soft reboot for 3 racks tomorrow 00:30-03:30 JST. Expected transient tail latency and a brief 5-10m capacity reduction per rack.

Ravi: Can you confirm the failure mode? Is this drop causing TCP retransmits or just counters? Any customer traffic lost?

Nora: Counters spike -> retransmits -> tail latency spikes and occasional client retries. No packet-level drops recorded at LB level, so requests still succeed but with elevated P95. Affects hosted pools and non-pinned dedicated nodes in apac-west1.

Sofie: Do we have a sequence to avoid KV cache churn? If we drain whole rack at once cold cache will hurt generation latency. Maybe do node-by-node with small overlap.

Diego: Suggest node-by-node stagger (10m per node) inside rack, rack rollover 45m apart. Run the NIC flash and then soft-reboot. We'll use the safe-flash workflow and validate tx/rx counters post-boot.

Nora: Proposed steps:
1) cordon rack -> node-by-node drain (10m)
2) flash NIC microcode: 
```
opsctl firmware apply --component nic --image s1-nic-2025-02-14.bin --nodes @rack-apacw1-a --dry-run=false
```
3) soft-reboot nodes, wait for net counters to stabilize (5m), run kv patch-warmup on node
4) uncordon
Runbook has rollback to previous image if error rate > 0.5% packets after 10m.

Ravi: Important: schedule fallback routing to apac-east/sea if regional P95 > 350ms. Also shorten batching for the window to avoid long tail.

Sofie: I'll add kv warmup snippet to uncordon hook: 
```
/opt/redwood/bin/kvseed --region apac-west1 --model frequent --rate 100/s --timeout 600
```
Also add an automated health check that probes the model endpoint p95 from two vantage points.

Diego: Cost note: cross-region overflow while rerouting may hit bandwidth caps. Estimate ~¥1.6k for 3h worst-case and some additional GPU-minutes. Ops finance informed?

Nora: Finance flagged the estimate but approved as emergency budget. We still want to keep cross-region <45m per rack if possible.

Ravi: Customer comms: small advisory to support/CS. Mention "possible increased latency and throttling; no data loss expected". Tag VIP tenants and ask for any embargoed workloads.

Sofie: I'll prepare the status-page blurb and short CS script. Diego, add the exact node lists and runbook IDs.

Diego: Node groups: rack-A nodes apacw1-a01..a09, rack-B apacw1-b01..b08, rack-C apacw1-c01..c06. Runbook id: RB-1124-nic-flash. Flash command will be executed from the central ops agent with a 10m per-node window.

Nora: Ops-bot please create calendar event and page oncall at T-45. Also enable automatic quantization fallback to quant-128 for latency-critical endpoints if P95 breaches threshold.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "apac-west1 NIC microcode rolling refresh" 2025-05-12 00:30-03:30 JST. Paging oncall at 23:45 JST.

Ravi: Add a preflight at T-2h to run load-sim checks and confirm backfill headroom >15%. If any validation fails, abort and reschedule.

Sofie: I'll add the health probes: p95 check + KV hit rate > 70% within 10m of uncordon.

Diego: During the roll we will emit telemetry markers: event=nic-refresh-start rack=<rack> and event=nic-refresh-end. Please filter in dashboards for per-tenant impact.

Nora: One more: disable large-bulk ingestion pipelines to apac-west1 during the maintenance window. Those jobs currently cause queuing and exacerbate retransmits. Ravi can you remind data-platform?

Ravi: On it. I'll message data-platform and cc CS.

Sofie: Acks from me. I'll also create a rollback playbook snippet to revert routes and reassign traffic back if tail latency persists.

Diego: Final confirmers? If no objections we go ahead with preflight at 21:30 UTC.

Nora: No objections. Preflight scheduled. Ping here for any late blockers.

ops-bot: PagerDuty page created: PD-35901 for apac-west1-team at 23:45 JST. Event link: https://pd.example/pd-35901

Ravi: Thanks all. Remember to capture per-tenant P95 and egress delta for the postmortem/cost report.

Sofie: Will collect traces and post rollout summary to #eng-telemetry within 6h of completion.
